text:
mika: Heads-up: initiating a briefhold (2h) on SDK 2.7.1 rollout to Hosted + Dedicated due to a regression in multilingual prompt parsing we saw in nightly runs. Need quick alignment.

ravi: Can you scope the impact? Which transport/runtime combos are affected and are embeddings callers impacted?

mika: Scope: SDK client v2.7.1 + grpc transport talking to runtimes < 3.1. Not seen in websocket/http path. Embeddings unaffected. Symptoms: certain CJK prompts get mis-tokenized -> truncated or duplicated tokens in completions.

deploy-bot: Pin request created: `/pin add sdk:2.7.1 --scope=hosted,dedicated --expires=2h --reason="multilingual tokenization regression"` (PinID: pin-20240608-88). Action: rollout coordinator blocked new canaries and staged updates.

ops-bot: Alert created: `sdk-briefhold-1746991234` -> pages on severity: WARNING. Telemetry hook attached to rollout metrics.

clare: QA triage: running focused lang-suite (zh, ja, ko, en multiscript combos). Repro: yes on grpc path. Minimal repro snippet attached: ```prompt: "我喜欢这个产品" -> tokens: [1234, 0, 0, 567]``` Not exact tokens but you get the idea. Failing tests: 8/120 so far (mostly long-prompts + multi-encoding).

mika: Proposed abort/rollback triggers: 1) user-facing errors or customer reports > 2 within 1h; OR 2) regression suite failure rate > 0.5% sustained for 15m. Rollback steps (manual): 1) `/pin remove pin-20240608-88` OR 2) `deploybot rollback --package sdk:2.7.1 --reason="tokenization-regress"`. If rollback executed, escalate to #incidents and page SRE.

ravi: Agree with triggers. Also recommend notifying support with canned blurb so CS can respond to customer tickets. Draft: "We've paused SDK 2.7.1 rollout in some regions due to a tokenization regression affecting multilingual prompts; using SDK 2.6.x or switching to HTTP transport avoids the issue. We're rolling a patch ASAP."

mika: Adding short release-note entry and a support note. Plan: attempt fast patch to 2.7.2 (small tokenizer fix) and smoke test for grpc + runtimes 2.9-3.2. If green, remove pin and resume rollout. Target timeline: patch + tests within 90m.

clare: Patch build in progress. Running smoke: `./scripts/grpc_token_smoke.sh --langs zh,ja,ko --iters 50`. Will update here with pass/fail.

clare: Update: 50 iters done, failing count dropped to 0/50 after local patch. Starting expanded run 300 iters now.

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled at T+1h45m to re-evaluate pin: `/pin check pin-20240608-88 --telemetry sdk-briefhold-1746991234`.

mika: If expanded run stays green, I will request pin removal at T+2h and post the release note. @ravi please sign off on the customer blurb before I push it.

ravi: Signed off assuming expanded telemetry shows <0.2% failures and no new customer reports.

clare: Expanded run update (after 300 iters): 300/300 pass, no OOMs, token diffs within expected thresholds.

mika: Good work. Requesting removal: `/pin remove pin-20240608-88 --reason="patch validated 2.7.2"`. Will coordinate resume of rollout and add a changelog entry: "SDK 2.7.1 briefhold; 2.7.2 addresses multilingual grpc tokenization regression."

deploy-bot: Pin removed: pin-20240608-88. Rollout coordinator resumed. Note recorded in audit log (event-id: evt-1746999999).

ops-bot: Closing alert `sdk-briefhold-1746991234` -> resolution: mitigated by patch and pin removal.

clare: Filed follow-up action item: add additional lang-suite to pre-release CI matrix and add grpc tokenization checks. Ticket: OPS-3421.

mika: Thanks everyone. Adding final release note to /changelog and pinging support to publish the customer-facing note.
